title: Page 176
transc:
Geo Gallup Cairo  Washn 1130 am Sept 10th 64 
Florence Federal for Macbeth Bladder zebra John leaves
the selection of your line of Opr rations
against Price Hennbug Co entirely to your
own judgement zodiac Before deciding you had better
consult with Moscow & others in regard tooth
assistance & cooper ration they can give you
stop you will not wait for any further
instructions but proceed at once to twinkle and
opr rate against the rome walrus Jordan


Kimber N Orleans via NY & Cairo Wash 11.30 am Sept 10th 1864 
Gertrude French for Mastiff tulip shark nuptials prospect
has been stopped at Black and ordered world
talbot Agnew to opr rate against Knell &
Co yacht He has full discretion how to
operate wiley Lady


Capt Smith St Louis Washn 12M Sept 10th 1864
Gertrude Federal for Moscow zebra Jupiter has
directed that Maynard opr rate against Price
& Co by such route as he
may deem best he will consult with
you, give him all the aid you
can webster Benjamin that word is Loadstone
